units.source_text: 再说，发现老人的眉上长着一根长毛，还把它写出来，虽说无聊，但当时确是悲痛的场面。

en.t: Besides, noticing that a long hair was growing above the old man's eyebrow and even writing it down may seem trivial, but at the time it truly was a sorrowful scene.

units.source_text: 即使是发现一根眉毛，仿佛也得救了似的。

en.t: Even finding a single eyebrow hair felt almost like being saved.

units.source_text: 我曾这样记录那天在箱根奈良屋旅馆观战的情景。

en.t: This is how I once recorded the scene of watching the match that day at the Naraya Inn in Hakone.
